name: io.github.DFM-Finance/dfm-agent
title: DFM · The Fund Management OS
description: Launch, deposit into, rebalance and redeem onchain funds on Solana mainnet.

environmentVariables.name: DFM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: dfm_ API key from app.dfm.finance → Agent → Keys (read-only by default). Optional for public reads.

environmentVariables.name: DFM_AGENT_WRITE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable the write tools (real money on Solana mainnet). Default false.

environmentVariables.name: DFM_MCP_CONFIRM_REQUIRED
environmentVariables.description: 1 = every write needs the human to type the tool name.
